list_apps.title: List apps
list_apps.description: List the workspace's AirOps apps (workflows and agents) with their uuids, names and inputs.

get_app.title: Get an app
get_app.description: Read one app: name, description, published versions and the input schema execute_app expects.

app_uuid.description: App uuid, from list_apps or the app's Integrate tab.

execute_app.title: Run an app and wait
execute_app.description: Run a published app with inputs and wait for the result. Fails if the run takes over ten minutes or the workspace is at capacity -- use async_execute_app for long runs. Spends credits.

app_uuid.description: App uuid, from list_apps or the app's Integrate tab.

version_slug.description: App version to run; defaults to the default version.

inputs.description: Input values keyed by the app's input names.

async_execute_app.title: Queue an app run
async_execute_app.description: Queue a run of a published app and return immediately with its execution uuid; poll get_execution for the result. Runs at the workspace's capacity and spends credits.

app_uuid.description: App uuid, from list_apps or the app's Integrate tab.

version_slug.description: App version to run; defaults to the default version.

inputs.description: Input values keyed by the app's input names.

get_execution.title: Get an execution
get_execution.description: Read an execution's status (pending, running, error, success, cancelled, review_needed), inputs, output, runtime and credits used.

list_app_executions.title: List an app's executions
list_app_executions.description: Page through every execution of an app with status, inputs and outputs.

airops_app_id.description: Numeric app id (the app's id, not its uuid).

cancel_execution.title: Cancel an execution
cancel_execution.description: Stop a pending or running execution; finished ones cannot be cancelled.

retry_execution.title: Retry an execution
retry_execution.description: Resume an errored execution from the step that failed. Spends credits for the remaining steps.

rate_execution.title: Rate an execution
rate_execution.description: Record positive, neutral or negative feedback on a successful execution.

chat_with_agent.title: Chat with an agent
chat_with_agent.description: Send a message to an Agent app and wait for its reply. Omit session_id to start a conversation; pass the returned one to continue it. Spends credits.

app_uuid.description: App uuid, from list_apps or the app's Integrate tab.

inputs.description: Input values for the agent, keyed by input name.

session_id.description: Session to continue; omit to start a new one.

async_chat_with_agent.title: Chat with an agent asynchronously
async_chat_with_agent.description: Send a message to an Agent app without waiting for the reply. Spends credits.

app_uuid.description: App uuid, from list_apps or the app's Integrate tab.

message.description: The message to send to the agent.

inputs.description: Optional inputs to send along with the message.

search_memory_store.title: Search a knowledge base
search_memory_store.description: Semantic search over a memory store's documents, optionally filtered on document metadata.

filter.description: Metadata filter as a JSON string, e.g. {"category": "faq"}.

add_memory_store_document.title: Add a document to a knowledge base
add_memory_store_document.description: Add a text document with a name and optional metadata to a memory store, where it is chunked and embedded for search.

update_memory_store_document.title: Update a knowledge base document
update_memory_store_document.description: Replace a memory store document's text, name and metadata; it is re-embedded.

memory_store_document_id.description: Document id within the memory store.

delete_memory_store_document.title: Delete a knowledge base document
delete_memory_store_document.description: Remove a document from a memory store so it no longer appears in search.

memory_store_document_id.description: Document id within the memory store.

generate_grid_csv.title: Generate a grid sheet CSV
generate_grid_csv.description: Start generating a CSV export of a grid sheet in the background. Download it with download_grid_csv when ready.

download_grid_csv.title: Download a grid sheet CSV
download_grid_csv.description: Download the most recently generated CSV of a grid sheet. 404 until generate_grid_csv has produced one.

list_brand_kits.title: List brand kits
list_brand_kits.description: List brand kits -- the brand, its competitors, product lines and prompts that every AEO insight is scoped to -- with the brand_kit_id the other tools need.

workspace_id.description: Workspace to read from; omit for every workspace the key belongs to.

includes.description: Related resources to include, e.g. product_lines, competitors.

sort.description: Sort field; prefix with - for descending.

get_brand_kit.title: Get a brand kit
get_brand_kit.description: Read one brand kit: brand name, workspace, domains and settings.

query_brand_kit_analytics.title: Query AEO analytics
query_brand_kit_analytics.description: Compute AI-search visibility metrics for a brand kit -- mention rate, share of voice, citation rate and count, sentiment, average position, first mention rate -- over a date range, grouped by up to three dimensions (date, provider, topic, country, persona, domain, competitor, domain_category, theme) at daily, weekly, monthly or total grain.

metrics.description: Metrics: mention_rate, positive_answer_rate, share_of_voice, citation_rate, citation_share, citation_count, sentiment_score, average_position, answer_count, first_mention_rate.

dimensions.description: Up to three of: date, provider, topic, country, persona, domain, competitor, domain_category, theme.

grain.description: Time granularity for aggregation. Default: total

end_date.description: End date (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to yesterday. Must be before today because today's data may still be processing and is incomplete — yesterday is used to ensure robust, complete data. Leave blank unless a specific date is requested.

providers.description: AI providers: chat_gpt, gemini, perplexity, google_ai_mode, google_ai_overview, claude, grok, microsoft_copilot.

themes.description: Sentiment theme ids; only affects sentiment_score.

brand_mentioned.description: Filter by prompt type. Options: category (generic prompts - recommended for accurate visibility metrics), brand (prompts mentioning the brand). Defaults to category if not specified

list_brand_kit_answers.title: List AI answers
list_brand_kit_answers.description: List individual AI assistant answers for a brand kit's prompts, with cited URLs and brand and competitor mentions, filtered by prompt, provider, country and whether the brand was mentioned.

start_date.description: Start date (ISO 8601) on aeo_analyses.created_at. Defaults to 30 days ago.

end_date.description: End date (ISO 8601) on aeo_analyses.created_at. Defaults to today.

prompt_id.description: Filter answers by a single prompt (question) ID.

providers.description: AI providers: chat_gpt, gemini, perplexity, google_ai_mode, google_ai_overview, claude, grok, microsoft_copilot.

brand_mentioned.description: When set, filter to answers where the brand was (or was not) mentioned.

fields.description: Extra fields to return, e.g. text, citations, mentions.

get_brand_kit_answer.title: Get an AI answer
get_brand_kit_answer.description: Read one AI answer with its text, citations and mentions.

start_date.description: Start date (ISO 8601) on aeo_analyses.created_at. Defaults to 30 days ago.

end_date.description: End date (ISO 8601) on aeo_analyses.created_at. Defaults to today.

prompt_id.description: Filter answers by a single prompt (question) ID.

providers.description: AI providers: chat_gpt, gemini, perplexity, google_ai_mode, google_ai_overview, claude, grok, microsoft_copilot.

brand_mentioned.description: When set, filter to answers where the brand was (or was not) mentioned.

list_brand_kit_citations.title: List citations
list_brand_kit_citations.description: List the URLs AI answers cite for a brand kit, with citation count, share, rate and influence score, filterable by domain, topic, page type and brand sentiment.

start_date.description: Start date for metrics (ISO 8601). Defaults to 1 month ago.

end_date.description: End date for metrics (ISO 8601). Defaults to today.

providers.description: AI providers: chat_gpt, gemini, perplexity, google_ai_mode, google_ai_overview, claude, grok, microsoft_copilot.

filters.description: Filters, each {field, operator, value}: domain_category, domain_id, topic_id, brand_mentioned, page_type, brand_referenced, brand_sentiment, mentioned_competitor_domains, url.

sort.description: citation_count, citation_share, citation_rate or influence_score; prefix - for descending.

get_brand_kit_citation.title: Get a citation
get_brand_kit_citation.description: Read one cited URL's metrics and page context.

start_date.description: Start date for metrics (ISO 8601). Defaults to 1 month ago.

end_date.description: End date for metrics (ISO 8601). Defaults to today.

providers.description: AI providers: chat_gpt, gemini, perplexity, google_ai_mode, google_ai_overview, claude, grok, microsoft_copilot.

list_brand_kit_competitors.title: List competitors
list_brand_kit_competitors.description: List the competitors tracked against a brand kit.

sort.description: name or created_at; prefix - for descending.

get_brand_kit_competitor.title: Get a competitor
get_brand_kit_competitor.description: Read one tracked competitor and its domain.

list_brand_kit_prompts.title: List prompts
list_brand_kit_prompts.description: List the questions tracked for a brand kit with volume, mention rate, positive answer rate and citation rate, filterable by tag, topic and date.

start_date.description: Start date for metrics (ISO 8601). Defaults to 1 month ago.

end_date.description: End date for metrics (ISO 8601). Defaults to today.

providers.description: AI providers: chat_gpt, gemini, perplexity, google_ai_mode, google_ai_overview, claude, grok, microsoft_copilot.

includes.description: Related resources to include: topic, tags.

sort.description: text, created_at, prompt_volume, mention_rate, positive_answer_rate or citation_rate; prefix - for descending.

get_brand_kit_prompt.title: Get a prompt
get_brand_kit_prompt.description: Read one tracked prompt (question) with its topic, tags and metrics.

list_brand_kit_personas.title: List personas
list_brand_kit_personas.description: List the personas a brand kit asks its prompts as.

sort.description: title or created_at; prefix - for descending.

get_brand_kit_persona.title: Get a persona
get_brand_kit_persona.description: Read one persona used to ask a brand kit's prompts.

list_brand_kit_topics.title: List topics
list_brand_kit_topics.description: List the topics grouping a brand kit's prompts.

sort.description: name or created_at; prefix - for descending.

get_brand_kit_topic.title: Get a topic
get_brand_kit_topic.description: Read one topic grouping a brand kit's prompts.

list_brand_kit_tags.title: List tags
list_brand_kit_tags.description: List the tags applied to a brand kit's prompts, for filtering analytics.

sort.description: name or created_at; prefix - for descending.

get_brand_kit_tag.title: Get a tag
get_brand_kit_tag.description: Read one tag applied to a brand kit's prompts.

get_sentiment_theme_answers.title: Get sentiment theme answers
get_sentiment_theme_answers.description: List the AI answers behind one sentiment theme, with sentiment details. Find theme ids with query_brand_kit_analytics grouped by theme.

end_date.description: End date (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to yesterday. Must be before today.

providers.description: AI providers: chat_gpt, gemini, perplexity, google_ai_mode, google_ai_overview, claude, grok, microsoft_copilot.

list_brand_kit_web_pages.title: List web pages
list_brand_kit_web_pages.description: List a brand's web pages with citations, clicks, impressions, traffic and GA4 or Amplitude key events, optionally through a preset such as almost_page_one, losing_clicks or losing_ai_visibility.

smart_filter.description: Apply a predefined filter preset. Available presets: - almost_page_one: Pages ranking 10-20 - losing_clicks: Pages losing clicks despite stable rankings - rankings_slipping: Pages declining in SERP - losing_ai_visibility: Pages losing AI citations - citation_rate_decline: Pages losing citation rate - stale_pages: Pages not updated in 6 months

start_date.description: Start date for analysis period (ISO 8601 format, defaults to 1 month ago)

end_date.description: End date for analysis period (ISO 8601 format, defaults to today)

event_names.description: GA4 key event names to include.

sort.description: Sort field such as citations_count; prefix - for descending.

output.description: A page of web page metrics.

list_content_updates.title: List content updates
list_content_updates.description: List the recorded page publishes and refreshes, to correlate content changes with AI visibility.

workspace_id.description: Workspace to read from; omit for every workspace the key belongs to.

sort.description: created_at, updated_at or url; prefix - for descending.

create_content_update.title: Record a content update
create_content_update.description: Record that a page was published or refreshed, with optional custom attributes, so its impact on AI visibility can be tracked.

get_content_update.title: Get a content update
get_content_update.description: Read one recorded page publish or refresh.

delete_content_update.title: Delete a content update
delete_content_update.description: Delete a recorded page publish or refresh.
